name: Lifestyle
description: Place the product in an aspirational everyday life moment that matches the audience.

scenes.label: Mood opener
scenes.visualDirection: Set the mood and the world of the audience.
scenes.promptScaffold: {audienceWho} on an easy, pleasant day in {setting}. {camera}. {lighting}. {toneMood}.

scenes.label: Product in daily life
scenes.visualDirection: The product naturally part of the routine.
scenes.promptScaffold: {audienceWho} naturally using {appearance} as part of their day in {setting}. {camera}. {lighting}. {toneMood}.

scenes.label: Social moment
scenes.visualDirection: A shared moment with friends or family.
scenes.promptScaffold: {audienceWho} sharing a relaxed moment with friends or family in {setting}. {camera}. {lighting}. {toneMood}.

scenes.label: Call to action
scenes.visualDirection: Product with offer and call to action.
